title: First Viennese School
extract: The First Viennese School is a name mostly used to refer to three composers of the Classical period in Western art music in late-18th-century to early-19th-century Vienna: Joseph Haydn, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and the first period of Ludwig van Beethoven. Sometimes, Franz Schubert is added to the list.
